name: crossword
description: A fullscreen crossword studio for ChatGPT. The model writes a fresh themed set of answers and clues, and the server builds a complete numbered grid for the conversation.

interface.longDescription: iPlugin Crossword is a deliberately distraction-free fullscreen crossword studio for ChatGPT. Every conversation gets a new themed puzzle: ChatGPT invents the answers and clues, and the server lays out a compact, fully connected grid, numbers every entry, and checks the intersections. The working area shows only the largest possible puzzle board and its clues; a slim top bar carries the mode and difficulty controls. There is no masthead, hero, toolbar, timer, progress ring, footer, theme switch, or completion card. The active clue is highlighted in the list. A top bar switches between Words, Numbers (Sudoku), Code, and Math, each with Easy, Standard, and Hard. Math is a math crossword: an irregular grid of across/down equations with fixed numbers and operators, blank input squares, a 0–9 keypad, and automatic checking when every blank is filled. Easy, Standard, and Hard use larger grids and all four operations. A small switch controls per-word checking: when on, each completed word immediately shows a check or turns red without revealing the exact wrong letters. The studio also checks the whole grid automatically when every square is filled: mistakes turn red with a count at the bottom of the clues, while a correct grid turns gold and every clue gets a check. Solve with the keyboard or a tap, switch across and down, and ask ChatGPT for another crossword whenever you want one; the new grid replaces the board in the same fullscreen view without opening a tab. The studio ships with 50 playable samples per mode and a visible New puzzle button that sends an English prompt to ChatGPT; samples and generated puzzles replace the current view in place without opening a tab. The full interface is localized into the 54 ChatGPT desktop locales, follows the host language, and offers an in-studio language menu. There is no account, OAuth or separate model API; puzzles live in the running server process for the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Make me a new crossword about the night sky.

positive.description: Open the studio and create a themed word crossword in one fullscreen surface.
positive.prompt: Make me a crossword about the night sky.
positive.expected_behavior: The studio opens as one fullscreen tab with a large starter crossword and numbered Across and Down clues. ChatGPT then replaces the starter with a night-sky puzzle in the same tab. No second tab, inline copy, masthead, timer, progress ring, or completion modal appears.

positive.description: Use the Numbers mode at Easy difficulty.
positive.prompt: Open the crossword studio and switch to Numbers on Easy difficulty.
positive.expected_behavior: The Numbers tab becomes active, an Easy Sudoku grid appears with the permanent How to play strip, and the number pad and clue-free grid are the only working area. The studio stays in the same tab.

positive.description: Use the Code mode and generate a fresh sample.
positive.prompt: Switch to the Code puzzle and give me a Standard sample.
positive.expected_behavior: The Code tab shows a color-code breaker with the Standard difficulty selected. The New puzzle action asks ChatGPT for another sample and replaces the grid in the same tab.

positive.prompt: Open the Math crossword on Hard difficulty.
positive.expected_behavior: The Math tab shows a numbered equation crossword with +, −, ×, and ÷ clues and a Hard difficulty selection. It is a crossword grid, not a multiple-choice quiz, and it opens in the existing tab.

positive.description: Replace the current puzzle without opening a new tab.
positive.prompt: Make me a different crossword about typography.
positive.expected_behavior: The open studio replaces the grid and clues with a new typography puzzle in the same fullscreen view. The previous puzzle is not shown in a second tab or a new conversation, and crossword_home is not called again.

negative.description: An unrelated question must not open the crossword studio.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: A crossword with only four answers must be rejected with a useful message.
negative.prompt: Make me a crossword with only four words.

negative.description: A clue that gives away its answer must not be accepted.
negative.prompt: Make a crossword where the clue for ORBIT is “ORBIT”.

publication.release_notes: 0.6.11 lists Trustflow as the developer and retains the anonymous usage statistics introduced in 0.6.10. 0.6.10 adds anonymous browser UUID daily active-user counts (Asia/Shanghai) and sanitized per-MCP-call events with best-effort UUID/context association. Analytics exclude tool arguments, results, game/puzzle/QR content and network identifiers. Events/context mappings expire after 400 days; daily activity hashes are retained until deletion is requested. New UI CSP permits https://iplugin.dev. The previously published UI resource remains available with unchanged HTML and CSP. Analytics failures do not block core tools. Unsupported interface.screenshots is removed; upload screenshots separately. See the updated plugin privacy policy and data deletion page.

en.subtitle: A fresh crossword, every time
en.description: Ask ChatGPT for a crossword about anything. It writes the answers and clues; the studio lays out a complete numbered grid. The interface is only the board and its clues. When the grid is full it checks itself: mistakes turn red, a correct grid turns gold, and every solved clue gets a check. Ask for another crossword to replace it in the same view.

zh.subtitle: 每一次，都是新填字
zh.description: 向 ChatGPT 要一张关于任何主题的填字。它写答案与线索，工作室排出一张完整、带编号的网格。界面只保留字谜盘和线索。填满后会自动检查：错误变红，全对时整盘变金色，每条完成的线索打勾。想换一张时，新网格会在同一个视图里直接替换。
